attributes.title: MAFP Spring Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Sheraton Flowood The Refuge Hotel & Conference Center
attributes.summary:
The Mississippi Academy of Family Physicians lists its 2027 Spring Conference for April 23 to 25 at the Sheraton Flowood The Refuge Hotel & Conference Center, just east of Jackson. A separate Spring Fling for students and residents runs at the same hotel on April 24 and 25.

The academy describes the usual format as a Saturday of CME sessions and exhibits followed by a Sunday-morning block that ends around lunch. For 2027 only the dates and venue were posted when we checked. Credits, fees and the hotel block were still to come, so confirm with MAFP before you register.
